plainText:
(Japanese: 衝撃！暗黒の未来 The Shocking Dark Future!) is the third chapter of the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Totodile, Honō, and Grovyle find themselves in the Dark Future.
Grovyle reveals to Totodile that Dusknoir is evil as he tries to execute the three.
With quick thinking, Honō frees everyone, allowing Grovyle to allow them to escape.
The three quickly separate after an argument but quickly regroup to find a way back in time.
After meeting with Celebi, the group goes to Passage of Time.
Upon arriving, they are ambushed by Dusknoir and Primal Dialga.
